title: Titles starting with The
statementMd:
List movies whose title starts with `The`.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title FROM movies WHERE title LIKE 'The %';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
